name: Down to Yuigahama
about: A proposed layout for the user's approval before the level is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8): the photographic KM2-1_down_to_yuigahama.png measured at about 120 px to the metre at the lane's fronts and spread along the lane in the order of its five lane pictures (KM2-1a to e), from the kid's home (x = -12, where every story level starts) to the boardwalk onto the sand. Game axes: x along the lane (m), z away from the camera (the play lane at z = 0), front: the z of a model's street face.
